scope: Application-level Inbox concurrent first-delivery owner fencing against an isolated real MySQL 8.4.11 sandbox

git.worktree_state: dirty; pre-existing and task-related changes were preserved and not committed

environment.isolation: isolated Docker container; dedicated sandbox database; no production connection

schema_baseline.type: minimal migration dependency chain; not a full V1-to-V120 production baseline

execution.command: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=<redacted>; SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=root; SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=<redacted>; mvn -pl zhicloud-server -am test -Dtest=EventInboxConcurrencyMysqlIntegrationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Dzhicloud.mysql.integration=true
verified_behaviors: The first thread entered the handler while holding the Inbox processing lease.
A concurrent second delivery returned IN_PROGRESS and did not execute the handler.
The final Inbox status was PROCESSED.

diagnostic_failure.result: Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0; BUILD FAILURE
diagnostic_failure.root_cause: PowerShell-to-mvn.cmd argument parsing split the datasource URL at the ampersand and the password system property was not passed; the JVM received a truncated URL and no password.
diagnostic_failure.classification: test harness invocation/environment defect, not an application or MySQL semantic failure
diagnostic_failure.resolution: Connection parameters were supplied through SPRING_DATASOURCE_* environment variables; the rerun passed.

proven: Real MySQL concurrent first-delivery CAS behavior for one Inbox row.
Application-level owner lease prevents a concurrent handler execution in the tested topology.
not_covered: Real read/write splitting or multi-tenant dynamic datasource topology.
Network partition and process crash/failover injection.
Outbox claim, publish, retry, dead-letter, replay and owner-fencing matrix.
Production data volume, latency, lock contention and long-running migration behavior.

limits: This is sandbox evidence and cannot be represented as production validation.
The database was a dedicated sandbox database in a single-node Docker container.
The schema baseline was a minimal dependency chain, not the complete production migration baseline.

reproducibility.prerequisite: Use the dedicated zhicloud_sandbox_chain database on the existing isolated MySQL sandbox container; do not use production credentials or databases.
reproducibility.secret_handling: The database password is intentionally omitted and must be injected through SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD at execution time.
notes: Run from the repository root with PowerShell.
Do not put the JDBC URL with query parameters directly on the mvn.cmd command line because cmd.exe treats ampersands as command separators.
